description:
A tour of dairy production bases in Hohhot, the "World Dairy Capital"
Hohhot, capital of north China's Inner Mongolia, was awarded the title of "World Dairy Capital" on Saturday at the 2026 World Dairy Industry Conference. Take a tour with us through farms and factories to see how technological innovation, digitalization and industrial integration are reshaping the city's dairy sector. (recorded) #ChinaTech #SmartFarming #DairyIndustry
title: tour of dairy production bases in Hohhot, the "World Dairy Capital"

description:
Twenty years ago, traveling to Xizang meant an arduous journey.
Today, the Qinghai-Xizang Railway has transformed the flow of people, goods and opportunities across the plateau.
